name: EAR YOGA
trialStarts: first launch on device; countdown preserved across updates
notes: Mobile release 1.51: completion card now has Next route and Menu. The solved sequence continues playing while the card stays open, with musical controls visible. Close X dismisses the award without stopping playback; Menu returns to the main cover and stops the flight. Student flying notes, existing achievement rules, original terrain, sound and gameplay are retained. Living atmospheric award art remains a separate local visual prototype.
